speaker: Mr Darryl David
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether the Government can provide an update on (i) the total number of beds available in shelters for the homeless and (ii) the average occupancy rate, in the past three years; (b) what is the average length of stay in a homeless shelter; and (c) whether there are plans put in place to help the homeless transition from a shelter to a more permanent place of residence in the mid- to long-term.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I think the Senior Parliamentary Secretary mentioned that the occupancy rate is 60%.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: This would suggest that there are vacancies in these shelters.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Notice of Motion.

speaker: Mr Speaker
